protocol: 20 official LitSearch intents disjoint from the first published 100, original English and Chinese rewrites with unchanged official labels. Rank in the shared positive pool plus 2,048 fixed extra searchable papers drawn by SHA-256 from other corpus records. 14 new intents based on two hash-sampled abstracts per venue use all 1,052 proceedings as competitors. Known-item scores give no credit for alternate relevant unjudged papers. Different candidate pools and label sources are reported separately. This is a fixed diagnostic sample, not a full-corpus leaderboard or a population-wide estimate.
